source: Evidence texts are paragraphs of Ch21.FaqEval/docs/pto-policy.md, ids in the Contoso v3 form doc@vN#paragraph. The Fabrikam and restricted questions get no evidence: the caller is not allowed any.

cases.question: How many PTO days do employees with 0-2 years of service get?

issued.pto-policy@v1#2:
Paid time off at Contoso is based on years of service:
- 0-2 years: 15 days per year
- 3-5 years: 20 days per year
- 6+ years: 25 days per year
issued.pto-policy@v1#3: PTO accrues monthly. Up to 5 unused days can carry over to the next year. Days beyond the carryover limit are forfeited on January 1.

cases.question: For an absence of 5+ consecutive days, how many days ahead must I submit the request?

issued.pto-policy@v1#5: Submit requests through the HR portal at least 2 weeks in advance. For absences of 5+ consecutive days, submit at least 30 days ahead. Managers approve within 3 business days.
